about.title: About 30 Year Fixed Mortgage Calculator - Traditional Home Loan Tool
about.description: The 30 Year Fixed Mortgage Calculator is the most comprehensive tool for calculating monthly payments, total interest costs, and affordability for traditional 30-year fixed-rate mortgages. This popular mortgage term offers the lowest monthly payments, making homeownership accessible to more buyers while providing payment stability over three decades. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer or refinancing, this calculator provides accurate projections for 30-year mortgage scenarios and helps you understand the long-term financial commitment.

faq.q: What are the advantages of a 30-year mortgage?
faq.a: 30-year mortgages offer the lowest monthly payments, making homes more affordable. They provide payment stability, preserve cash flow for other investments, and offer maximum mortgage interest tax deductions. This makes homeownership accessible to more buyers.

faq.q: How much house can I afford with a 30-year mortgage?
faq.a: Generally, your monthly housing payment shouldn't exceed 28% of gross monthly income. With a 30-year mortgage's lower payments, you can typically afford a more expensive home compared to shorter loan terms, but consider total interest costs.

faq.q: Should I pay extra on my 30-year mortgage?
faq.a: Extra principal payments can save substantial interest and shorten your loan term. However, consider opportunity costs - if you can invest extra money at returns higher than your mortgage rate, investing might be more beneficial.

faq.q: When does PMI get removed from a 30-year mortgage?
faq.a: PMI is typically removed when you reach 20% equity (80% loan-to-value ratio). This can happen through payments reducing the balance, property appreciation, or a combination. You can request removal or it's automatically canceled at 22% equity.
